---
title: "Sankey Diagram"
subtitle: "Visualize how income flows into spending categories"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

Select a date range and category level, then click **Generate** to build the Sankey diagram.
Income flows into spending categories; any surplus appears as Savings.

<div class="control-bar">
  <label for="sankey-start">Start:</label>
  <input type="month" id="sankey-start">

  <label for="sankey-end">End:</label>
  <input type="month" id="sankey-end">

  <label for="sankey-level">Level:</label>
  <select id="sankey-level">
    <option value="category_l1" selected>L1 (broad)</option>
    <option value="category_l2">L2 (detailed)</option>
  </select>

  <button id="sankey-generate">Generate</button>
</div>

<div id="sankey-loading" class="loading-spinner">Initializing DuckDB-Wasm…</div>
<div id="sankey-chart" class="chart-container" style="display:none; min-height:500px;"></div>

::: {.callout-tip}
## Tip
Try the L2 level to see subcategory detail (e.g., Groceries, Restaurants, Coffee Shops within Food).
Narrow the date range to focus on specific periods like before/after a job change.
:::

```{=html}
<script type="module">
import { renderSankey, initDateBounds } from "./assets/js/sankey_ui.js";

const startInput = document.getElementById("sankey-start");
const endInput = document.getElementById("sankey-end");
const levelSelect = document.getElementById("sankey-level");
const generateBtn = document.getElementById("sankey-generate");
const loadingDiv = document.getElementById("sankey-loading");
const chartDiv = document.getElementById("sankey-chart");

async function generate() {
  const start = startInput.value ? startInput.value + "-01" : null;
  const end = endInput.value ? endInput.value + "-01" : null;
  const level = levelSelect.value;

  if (start && end && start > end) {
    alert("Start date must be before end date.");
    return;
  }

  loadingDiv.style.display = "none";
  chartDiv.style.display = "block";
  await renderSankey("sankey-chart", { level, start, end });
}

generateBtn.addEventListener("click", generate);

// Initialize date bounds and render default
(async () => {
  await initDateBounds(startInput, endInput);
  loadingDiv.textContent = "Ready — click Generate";
  loadingDiv.classList.remove("loading-spinner");
})();
</script>
```
